entries.characterVersion: Senshi, Dungeon Meshi anime2024 dwarf cook: very stocky muscular adult dwarf, huge dense black beard and moustache, round nose, steel helmet with two short brown horns and cheek guards, bare muscular upper arms, dark sleeveless tunic/leather apron, brown fur-trimmed lower clothes, leather wrist guards, sturdy brown/steel boots. Practical single-headed steel axe carried for ordinary attacks; iron pot and ladle only when actually cooking. No gun, magic wand or elemental attack.

entries.sourceReference: Dungeon Meshi : Falin est une utilisatrice de magie de soin et de protection ; action fondée sur ses soins, pas sur sa transformation forcée.
entries.characterVersion: Falin Touden in her ordinary HUMAN form from Dungeon Meshi anime2024: young adult human woman with short chin-length tousled pale ash-blond bob, soft round face, small HUMAN rounded ears, gentle usually closed/slightly opened eyes, white high-collared long-sleeved ankle-length tunic/robe, simple medium green shoulder cloak/cape secured at neck, brown leather belt and brown boots. No long blond elf braids, pointed elf ears, red ribbon, blue Marcille robe, feathers, dragon body, chimera, tail, wings or transformation. Healer with empty caring hands, no beam cannon or offensive spell weapon.
